A general told Kevin retreat and regroup are not the same thing.

Kevin explains that he was travelling with General Norman Schwarzkopf and asked how he saw an army pulling back. The general answered that they never retreat, they regroup.

Technically it is the same action, the general said, but it feels completely different because of how you look at it.

Kevin then flips the half full, half empty glass. A wealthy person, he says, simply knows the glass can always be refilled.

Where in your life could a new way of looking change everything?
